title: The Second Book of Vital Breath
summary: A second book that builds on the plain breath of vitality and adds the first clearing of fever and a firmer guard.

title: A Treatise on the Tireless Pulse
summary: A treatise on keeping an ally's heart strong through a long struggle and clearing the weariness that gathers after it.

title: The Cleansing Breath Course
summary: A course on drawing mild poisons and taints out of an ally with the breath while keeping the wound closed.

title: A Handbook of Deep Renewal
summary: A handbook that carries vitality below the skin to mend torn muscle and bruised bone and to jolt an attacker.

title: The Vitality Reckoner
summary: A reckoner for sizing up an ally's strength and spending vitality where it is most needed.

title: The Canon of the Flowing Sap
summary: A canon of the steady current of vitality that mends the hurt and clears the foul and can be turned against a foe.

title: A Compendium of Tireless Hands
summary: A compendium for healers who work long hours and need to cleanse and mend and still turn a blow aside.

title: The Evergreen Method
summary: A method for staying hale through hard work that teaches the cleansing of taint and the quick return of vigor.
